name: Azerbaijan
blurb: Flame Towers, a walled old city and mud volcanoes.
cities: A walled old city beside futuristic towers.
A silk-road town with a painted Khan's Palace.
Ancient rock carvings and bubbling mud volcanoes.
A mountain village of stone houses at 2,300 metres, on an ancient herding route.
Humid relict forests, tea gardens and waterfalls near Lankaran.
